features.title: Close the P0 site audit issues: canonical URLs, advertising, responsive layout
scope: Canonical URLs resolve to each page's own permalink
Ad placement decided in this repository, not by AdSense Auto ads
No page-level horizontal overflow at any tested viewport width
Article body text readable on phones and a bounded measure on desktop
done_criteria: Every generated page carries exactly one absolute HTTPS canonical equal to its own permalink, with og:url in agreement
At most one AdSense loader and one initialisation per page, no Auto ads, no ad above a heading
Article text is at least 16px on phones and runs at roughly 72 characters per line on desktop

verification.evidence: Built-site checks pass across 126 pages. Responsive checks pass across 13 pages and 7 widths. A forced 970px ad creative stays contained at 360px and 390px in a production-shaped build. Both check families were confirmed to fail on an injected regression.

features.open_follow_up: The in-article ad unit renders only once adsense.in_article_slot is set in _config.yml.
